gloss: wind direction; trend; way things are going

definitions.explanation: The direction from which the wind is blowing.

definitions.gloss: trend; way things are going; mood
definitions.explanation: The general direction of a situation, attitude, or trend. Used figuratively to describe shifting circumstances or public opinion.

examples.japanese: {風向|かざむ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{風向|かざむ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{帆|ほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Adjust the sails based on the wind direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{風向|かざむ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the afternoon, the wind shifted to the north and it suddenly got cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風向|かざむ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風向|かざむ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Speak up after reading the boss's mood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風向|かざむ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: As the election approached, the political winds shifted dramatically.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind) + ⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧ (direction). The reading {風|かざ} uses the older combining form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風向|かざむ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (the wind/trend changes)
- {風向|かざむ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (check the wind/read the situation)
- {風向|かざむ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (the wind/mood is unfavorable)

The figurative use (sense 2) is very common and parallels the English expression "which way the wind is blowing."
